description: This file defines the ListViewData class which manages data retrieval, sorting, pagination, and additional details for list views in a SuiteCRM (SugarCRM-derived) application. It includes methods for generating list queries, handling user preferences, managing URLs for paging, and fetching supplementary record details via AJAX.

classes.name: ListViewData
classes.description: Encapsulates data handling for list views, including query generation, sorting, pagination, and auxiliary details, designed for SuiteCRM list views.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ListViewData instance, setting default limit name and database connection.

methods.name: getOrderBy
methods.description: Determines the field and direction for sorting based on request parameters, session, and user preferences.

methods.name: getReverseSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the opposite sort order ('ASC' to 'DESC' or vice versa) for toggling sorting in the UI.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum number of records to display per page from configuration.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Retrieves current pagination offset from request parameters.

methods.name: getBaseQuery
methods.description: Constructs and returns the base URL parameters, excluding certain block variables, to be used for generating pagination and sorting URLs.

methods.name: setVariableName
methods.description: Sets session and request variable names based on the list view context, module, and optional ID.

methods.name: getTotalCount
methods.description: Executes a count query to determine the total number of records matching current filters.

methods.name: getListViewData
methods.description: Main method that creates and executes list queries with sorting, pagination, and filtering. It handles data retrieval, augmenting rows with additional details, and preparing pagination URLs and metadata.

methods.name: generateURLS
methods.description: Builds URL strings from query arrays for navigation links.

methods.name: generateQueries
methods.description: Creates query arrays for pagination controls based on current sorting and offset information.

methods.name: getAdditionalDetailsAjax
methods.description: Generates a clickable span element for AJAX-based fetching of additional record details.

methods.name: getAdditionalDetails
methods.description: Generates HTML content for extra record details, including edit and view links for display in detail popups.
